title: Lawsuit Accuses Education Dept. of Throttling Debt Cancellation Through PSLF Program
description: Public servants on the brink of student debt forgiveness are facing setbacks and extensive delays. The American Federation of Teachers sued to help them.
aiSummary: 美国教师联合会（AFT）近日对美国教育部提起诉讼，指控其在执行“
